title: Start the full-local infrastructure stack with one Compose command
user_visible_behavior: so that Redis, RabbitMQ, CouchDB, MinIO, and Mailpit are healthy and persistent without cloud services
evidence: Compose valid; 5/5 services healthy; persistence survived down/up; Pester 23/23; review APPROVED

title: Run both backends against local endpoints without cloud credentials
user_visible_behavior: so that login, menu read, order creation, and order status updates work entirely on the local machine
evidence: Phase 02 APPROVED: 88 migrations; idempotent local seed; health/login/JWT/refresh verified. Phase 03 verified: Kiosk health/ping auth on 5160, MainBackendClient localhost routing, CouchDB/RabbitMQ persistence across two restarts. Test-LocalBusinessFlow verifies kiosk menu read, local RESO order creation, sandbox-success callback, Preparing -> Completed workflow, admin order read, order-details read, and idempotent callback replay.

title: Use local auth, storage, email, payment, and webhook providers
user_visible_behavior: so that business flows preserve existing contracts without Firebase, Supabase, external SMTP, or payment accounts
evidence: Payment intentionally deferred per user direction: sandbox UI uses a local success button and does not call VNPay/MPOS. Local auth, MinIO adapter, Mailpit SMTP, and Main -> Kiosk webhook are active. Webhook inbox/outbox is persisted in AutoBrewing_BE_Local with unique replay keys and restart replay verified. Product image upload/read round-trip through MinIO verified byte-for-byte by scripts/local/Test-MinioObjectStorage.ps1.

title: Run kiosk workflows with simulator or explicitly mapped real hardware
user_visible_behavior: so that workflows can be tested without USB devices and operated with validated Windows COM mappings
evidence: Simulator project builds; SQLite journal self-test verifies atomic command claims, durable Completed replay, restart-to-Unknown, explicit operator reconciliation and no automatic retry; RabbitMQ command was published and consumed from device-command; Test-SimulatorWorkflow reaches Done/Observed under 30 seconds through the Kiosk observer. Five .NET 8 native controllers now select the shared durable local RabbitMQ command host in HARDWARE_MODE=real and build with the local credential configuration; Coffee smoke-start created its per-device queue and SQLite journal without Azure credentials. ArmController2 still needs its .NET Framework compatibility bridge. Serial inventory reports only Bluetooth COM17/COM18; Test-HardwareProfile blocks real mode until verified wired mappings exist.

title: Centralize local Next.js and Flutter endpoints
user_visible_behavior: so that web and mobile clients cannot accidentally call production API, refresh, export, or SignalR URLs in local mode
evidence: Next.js build, executable URL scan, FVM 3.41.9 Flutter analyze and Flutter test pass. Tracked FE sample configuration now uses localhost:5100 for API proxy, API base and SignalR hub.
